title: An untrusted checkout with its own Claude configuration is raised once at up and the loop stops relaunching
description: A checkout carrying .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json, untrusted in two registered Claude accounts: up stops at the harness step naming both account homes and both remedies (operator trust once per account, or the role's --setting-sources user); the Setup checklist shows the loop's standing line as one item; and the loop holds the named roles' launches behind one attention line, opening no pane per retry, until the account configs record trust or the role gains --setting-sources user.
